The '''Chevin Conglomerate''' was the main government of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Vinsoth/Legends|Vinsoth]] during the centuries leading up to the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. The Conglomerate had many underworld connections, though they preferred to stay neutral and distant from the conflicts between the two galactic powers since their military strength was minor.

However, around [[3639 BBY]], the Conglomerate announced the [[Grand Acquisitions Race]]&mdash;a competition between [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]], [[Scavenger/Legends|scavengers]], criminals, and [[Agent/Legends|agents]] from both sides of the war to recover a set of rare and unrelated objects for the Conglomerate. These items would be used by the [[Chevin/Legends|Chevin]] as an offering to the ancient [[Gree (species)/Legends|fleet]] species, a fleet of which they had learned was returning to known space.

==History==
The Conglomerate served as the main government of [[Vinsoth/Legends|Vinsoth]] during the centuries leading up to the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. While neutral toward those major galactic governments, the Conglomerate was ill regarded, especially by the Republic, who condemned their use of [[slavery]], and their links with various crime syndicates.

Around [[3639 BBY]], while the Galactic War raged on, the [[Chevin/Legends|Chevin]] organization decided to launch the [[Grand Acquisitions Race]]&mdash;a competition between [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]], [[Scavenger/Legends|scavengers]], criminals, and [[Agent/Legends|agents]] from both sides of the war to recover a set of rare and unrelated objects for the Conglomerate, promising to give fortunes in return for the objects. [[Apharu Moh]] announced it through the use of a sizeable [[Holocomm/Legends|holocomm]] placed in [[Lucent Square]] in a [[Promenade|commercial territory]] of [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]]. The Race was however, a facade to disguise the Chevin's true plans.
